test_split_arguments: test BasicSweeper.split_arguments to generate cartesian products of sweep overrides with optional batching
test_partial_failure: test Hydra multirun partial failure handling when one job raises ZeroDivisionError
run_split_with_range: run BasicSweeper.split_arguments with range sweep overrides like a=range(0,3) to expand values
run_split_with_batching: run BasicSweeper.split_arguments with max_batch_size to chunk cartesian product results into batches
run_multirun_with_overrides: run a Hydra multirun job with comma-separated sweep overrides using run_process utility
